card.title: 87. GRENADIER
card.text: Give +2+2 when the enemy triggers your countermeasure.
card.flavorText: The 87th Grenadier Regiment was a unit of the 36th Infantry Division of the Wehrmacht during WWII. The division participated in the invasion of France and later in Operation Barbarossa as part of the XXXXI Panzer Corps of the Army Group North. The division participated in various battles and operations on the Eastern Front and in the summer of 1944 during Operation Bagration the division was largely destroyed. The division was reformed in France later that year, and renamed to 36th Volksgrenadier Division, and would defend against the Allied advance in France, Luxembourg and the Saarland. The division ended the war defending against Patton’s 3rd Army in central Germany.
